about_short_description.short_description: 222 is a social app that gives opportunity for its users to connect and meet new people, discover the city, and deepen their relationships.

product.name: 222 Mobile App
product.description: A mobile social platform that uses user profiles and survey responses to connect people, recommend social experiences, and help users meet in person.

product.name: 222 Social Matching and Experience Platform
product.description: A platform that matches users with compatible people and venues for group social experiences based on survey responses, interests, and interaction data.

product.name: In-Person Social Experiences
product.description: Organized group gatherings that enable users to meet new people at participating restaurants, venues, and other locations.

product.name: Venue and Restaurant Partnership Services
product.description: Partnership services for restaurants and venues that host 222 social experiences and receive groups of matched participants.
